Anonymous points and vectors and segments and lines and rays and circles and conics draw and can be picked. Named members keep their own drawings. Bare numbers and Booleans suppress list graphics. Uses up to 256 work units per list and 512 shared by desktop fit and paint or 4096 per SVG pass or pointer query. Anonymous circles and conics cost 64 units each. Create List accepts the supported rectangle shapes with at most 256 objects and 16 KiB of labels. Rectangle selection and filtering share 4096 units for candidates and shape preparation (including vector start dependencies) and vertex reads and journal operations. Exhaustion cancels the operation. Transformed shapes allow 64 preparation levels and clipped polygons need cached contours. Import rebuilds supported construction lists. Drop-down presentation is outside graphics list coverage. Export: its definition needs a saved form; the drop-down display with its selected index and the font and rounding of a list are not kept.

The axes belong to the graphics view. Axis operands are reserved lines rather than recorded Axis objects. The SVG writer has no view decoration and the algebra view has no axis rows. Move Graphics View can resize an axis. Saved view settings retain separate axis visibility flags. The canvas uses a shared axes toggle.
Static and dependent texts with saved world or pixel placement and LaTeX typesetting. An empty text draws nothing. Export: its definition needs a saved form; the symbolic mode is not kept.
LaTeX formulas use Text. The Text tool creates plain text and has no LaTeX option. Export: its definition needs a saved form; the symbolic mode is not kept.

Desktop draws and picks the same first 10001 samples including isolated samples. The locus tool takes a path point or slider in either order with its dependent point. Export: its definition needs a saved form; no witness for draw_arrows.
Up to 512 intervals per plot draw clipped polylines. Cartesian replots cost four units of the shared 24-unit frame allowance or 12 while panning. Export: its definition needs a saved form.

Boolean regions use at most a 64 by 64 grid for up to two regions per desktop frame or eight per SVG across all layers. Numeric functions of two variables are algebra only in the 2D view. Import rebuilds supported saved expressions. Export: its definition needs a saved form; the level of detail is not kept.
